title: JSFL: fl.openDocument, fl.closeDocument, doc.currentTimeline, library.itemExists stubs
description: Add 4 small missing JSFL stubs to packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts: (1) fl.openDocument(fileURL) - warn+return getDocumentDOM() stub; (2) fl.closeDocument(doc, bPromptToSaveChanges?) - warn+return true; (3) doc.currentTimeline: number - getter returning current scene index (0); (4) library.itemExists(name) - return state.doc.library.items.some(i => i.name === name). All 4 additions to same file.
